e: Three-year McDonald Institute Theory Fellowship in astroparticle theory and phenomenology (neutrinos, dark matter, physics beyond the Standard Model) with the UdeM phenomenology group. Applicants need a PhD in physics or astronomy before the start; no citizenship limit is stated.
